(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM orders o
  WHERE ((o.id = delivery_tasks.order_id) AND ((o.branch_id = ( SELECT profiles.branch_id
           FROM profiles
          WHERE (profiles.id = auth.uid()))) OR (get_user_role() = 'SUPER_ADMIN'::text)))))
